title: Artificial Intelligence in Construction: Building a Sustainable Future
description: AI is used in construction for planning, safety monitoring, materials, scheduling, sustainability, and the messy realities of actual building sites.
short_description: A plain-English guide to planning, safety, budgets, materials, and why construction AI has to work on sites, not just slides.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in Construction for developers, site managers, architects, and readers tracking the built environment.
